title: 'Important' filter gets wrong result with default 'Yes'

issues.title: 'Important' filter gets wrong result with default 'Yes'
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
'Important' filter has default value is 'Yes' and the result of filter is all items. It should only show the result which match with default 

**Update from Ian:** the `important` boolean filter should have a third `Empty` state, which does not try to match anything.  When added, the filter component will be in this state.  The user then selects a boolean state, and the filter is applied.

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Click on channel 'Core Mapping'
3. Add filter with 'Important'
4. Notice the default filter 'Important' is yes
5. Notice 'Items' panel shows all items instead of it shows the items which are matched with 'Important' = Yes

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/44c3bfa6-8612-4581-a41a-4d5fc7b53a36)

View below screencast for more details
## ⚙️ Expected behavior
'Important' filter has default value is 'Yes' and the result of filter is all items. It should only show the result which match with default 

## 🖥️ Screencasts


https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/7258d86a-7aba-4865-9438-ca9277c3e139


## 💻 System information
<!-- Please complete the following information (you can get most of this information from https://mybrowser.fyi/) -->
 - Browser : Chrome
 - Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111


## 📝 Additional context
